correctness.rationale: For gcd>1 an alternating residue-class linear relation among complete window sums determines the erased coordinate. For gcd=1 full circulant is invertible and a primitive integer kernel v has m entries r−ℓ and n−m entries r with surviving windows summing to zero; integer differences within fibers are multiples of v because gcd(r,ℓ−r)=1. Fibers are finite chains, so image size equals q^n minus allowable x→x+v edges; the edge product and sharp maximum chain length follow coordinatewise. Independent exhaustive enumeration confirmed 63 cases and full fiber preservation in noncoprime cases.
